    By codex

    Pages with DSE problems, by book of the Iliad

    Passages are compared by version: a line counts as in the DSE if any record names it, in either exemplar (diplomatic or normalized); a scholion's lemma and comment are one passage. Subreferences (1.1@word) are ignored. A codex page counts as covered if any record names it as its surface; the runs of pages that no record names are listed in codex order. In the summary by manuscript, records are counted by the codex page they name as surface; inconsistencies are those records whose passage is not in the editions or whose image is not in the catalog, plus the runs of pages without records. Findings are warnings only.
